notes: Spec asserts: state stays ready during /usage and /status (both genuinely local -- see parser.go's payloadTypeCommandInvoked -> Skip=true, "Bookkeeping, not a turn boundary", live-confirmed in two real sessions where command.invoked is the session's last line with nothing following). Unlike claudecode/antigravity, muse needs NO warm-up turn first -- session.jsonl materializes at session-open (2-1_basic-turn sibling cell), so slash_window anchors directly off session_birth. command.invoked never reaches events.jsonl (Skip=true), so this spec can only assert the ABSENCE of a working/waiting transition during the window, not the PRESENCE of the slash invocation itself -- record's verify step separately greps the raw transcript.jsonl for the two command.invoked records as the positive check (see metadata.json caveats).
